quest.title: The Bountiful Bottle
quest.description: Legends tell of an extraordinarily devised bottle that could hold any liquid known to man, even Acid! Perhaps some investigation in a place of knowledge could uncover secrets of the crafting of this wondrous receptacle.

node.tag: Legends tell of a special bottle that can hold any liquid...discuss.
node.journal_entry: A book titled "Magnificent Devices" found inside the Amethyst Athenaeum had more information about how to craft the bottle.

task.task_instruction: Search the Amethyst Athenaum for clues about the bottle
